RE1210* Re-written to use new RSP06GCI structure and to process new    *
RE1210* bookings. Handles CXP, APX logic, calls all subroutines, and   *
RE1210* CABIN-HOLD-REC logic. Cabin and Pax level edits are done in    *
RE1210* RSO26EGC, database updates are done in RSO29UGC, which calls   *
RE1210* RSO29GCH for creating history.                                 *

           IF  RSP06-IBR-SSCIR-TABLE-ID OF RSP06-NEW > SPACES AND

       3410-NEXT-PAX-CHG-ON-PBS.
           ADD 1 TO NSUB.   

       3411-CHECK-PAX-CHG-ON-PBS.   

           IF NSUB > RSP06-PAX-CNT OF RSP06-NEW 
             GO TO 3420-CHECK-IBPIR 
           END-IF.

             GO TO 3410-NEXT-PAX-CHG-ON-PBS 
           END-IF.  

           IF  WS-CANCEL-PBS-UPG-IND = 'Y'  
             GO TO 3415-PAX-CANCEL-PBS  
           END-IF.  

           IF  WS-PAX-RATE-CHG-FLAG (NSUB) = 1  
               MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CANCEL-OPN-PRM-PBS-IND
           ELSE 
              IF  WS-PAX-RPU-CHG-FLAG (NSUB) = 1
      *            Rate pricing parameters changed.  Both open and  
      *            redeemed promo upgrade offers must be discarded. 
      *            Any redemptions and upgrade amounts must remain as   
      *            they are unless upgrade amounts also adjusted.   
                  MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CANCEL-OPN-PRM-PBS-IND 
              END-IF

              IF  (  RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)  
                   < RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB)) 
      *        Upgrade amount is being reduced.  Open offers
      *        invalidated. 
      *        (NOTE: Check is valid based on assumption that   
      *        CXP shifts of upgrade amount occur later in  
      *        4275-FINISH-CXP.  If this check were to occur
      *        after shift, then compare at same position.) 
                  MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CANCEL-OPN-PRM-PBS-IND 

      *        Check further if minimum (non-manual) amounts as 
      *        stamped on IBPIR entries are still covered.  
                  PERFORM 8910-TOT-PAX-IBPIR-UPG
                         THRU 8919-EXIT 
                  IF  (  RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)  
                          < WS-TOT-PAX-IBPIR-UPG)   
                      MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CANCEL-RDM-PRM-PBS-IND 
                  END-IF
              ELSE  
                  IF  (  RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)  
                       > RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB)) 
      *             Manually increasing upgrade amount only 
      *             invalidates open upgrade offers.
                      MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CANCEL-OPN-PRM-PBS-IND 
                  END-IF
              END-IF
           END-IF.  
           GO TO 3410-NEXT-PAX-CHG-ON-PBS.  

       3415-PAX-CANCEL-PBS. 

           IF      (OSUB > 0)   
      *      If the booking rate changed, but not the CPA, then the 
      *      rate change could be a manual change to resolve some   
      *      issue other than guests shopping for a different   
      *      cabin.  Right now, we don't have enough input data to  
      *      know for sure.  So, we'll send an informational message
      *      for each upgrade amount expected to be removed.

              IF      (  RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB)  
                         > 0)   
                 AND (RSP25-CALL-CENTER-FLAG = 1)   
                 AND (WS-CHG-RATE-FLAG = 1) 
                 AND (WS-NEW-BKG-FLAG = 0)  
                 AND (WS-REACTIVATE-FLAG = 0)   
                 AND (RSP25-EXCHANGE-CABIN-FLAG = 0)
                 AND (  RSP06-IBR-CPA-CATEGORY-CODE OF RSP06-OLD

PBS-P1*    -------------------- 
PBS-P1*    An adjustment to manually set upgrade amount should  
PBS-P1*    be made when CXP reduces booking to a single.  For later 
PBS-P1*    phases of PBS, when upgrade amount is computed, this code
PBS-P1*    block can be removed.  (Mike Evert)  
PBS-P1  
PBS-P1     IF      (NSUB = 1)   
PBS-P1         AND (RSP06-PAX-CNT OF RSP06-NEW = 1) 
PBS-P1         AND (RSP06-PAX-CNT OF RSP06-OLD > 1) 
PBS-P1  
PBS-P1*      If new amount is being submitted on input, assume user 
PBS-P1*      is taking responsibility for the adjustment. Comparing 
PBS-P1*      position of guest not old guest, use NSUB for both..   
PBS-P1       IF      (  RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)   
PBS-P1                = RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-OLD (NSUB))  
PBS-P1  
PBS-P1         COMPUTE RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)
PBS-P1             =   RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-OLD (1)   
PBS-P1               + RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-OLD (2)   
PBS-P1  
PBS-P1*        The following is best but commented out because there
PBS-P1*        is no certainty that singles percent would be stamped
PBS-P1*        on guest before CXP to single is completed.  
PBS-P1  
PBS-P1*        COMPUTE RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)
PBS-P1*            =   RSP06-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)
PBS-P1*              * RSP06-PAX-SINGLES-PCT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)
PBS-P1  
PBS-P1       END-IF 
PBS-P1     END-IF.

           ADD WS-PAX-PEN-COMM-AMT     TO WS-BKG-PENALTY-MAX-AMT.

           IF WS-BKG-PENALTY-MAX-AMT < ZERO

                  IF RSP06-PDI-PEN-CRUISE-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) > ZERO
                     MOVE ZERO TO WS-BKG-PENALTY-MAX-AMT
                  ELSE  
                     MOVE RSP06-PDI-PEN-CRUISE-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)

           END-IF.

                  RSP06-PDI-PEN-ADDON-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)

                  ELSE  
                     MOVE RSP06-PDI-PEN-ADDON-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)   
                       TO WS-BKG-PENALTY-MAX-AMT
                     MOVE ZERO TO   
                          RSP06-PDI-PEN-ADDON-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)   
                  END-IF
           END-IF.

                  RSP06-PDI-PEN-XFR-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)

                  ELSE  
                     MOVE RSP06-PDI-PEN-XFR-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)

           END-IF.

              GO TO 6010-NEXT-NEW-PAX   
           END-IF.

              GO TO 6010-NEXT-NEW-PAX   
           END-IF.

           END-IF.

             ADD RSP15-O-SINGLES-PCT (PEN-RSUB PEN-CSUB) TO

           END-IF.

           IF WS-NEW-BKG-FLAG = 1 OR WS-REACTIVATE-FLAG = 1 OR

           MOVE ZERO TO OSUB.   

       7300-NEXT-CRUISE-REVENUE.
           ADD 1 TO OSUB.   

           IF OSUB <= RSP06-PAX-CNT OF RSP06-OLD
              IF OSUB <= RSP06-PAX-CNT OF RSP06-NEW

                     WS-OLD-CRUISE-AMT  
      *     Position cruise compare, not guest compare  
                 ADD RSP06-PDI-CRUISE-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (OSUB) TO
                     WS-NEW-CRUISE-AMT  
              ELSE  
                 IF OSUB = 2
                    COMPUTE WS-OLD-CRUISE-AMT = WS-OLD-CRUISE-AMT + 
                            (RSP06-PAX-SINGLES-PCT OF RSP06-NEW (1) - 1)
                            * RSP06-PDI-CRUISE-AMT OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB)  
                 END-IF 
           ELSE 
              IF OSUB > RSP06-PAX-CNT OF RSP06-NEW OR 2 
                 GO TO 7325-CRUISE-REVENUE-INCREASE 
              ELSE  
                 COMPUTE WS-NEW-CRUISE-AMT = WS-NEW-CRUISE-AMT +
                         (RSP06-PAX-SINGLES-PCT OF RSP06-OLD (1) - 1)   
      *    Position cruise compare, not guest compare   
                         * RSP06-PDI-CRUISE-AMT OF RSP06-NEW (OSUB).

           GO TO 7300-NEXT-CRUISE-REVENUE.

              GO TO 8530-CHECK-FORCED-OVERNIGHT.

           IF RSP06-PTFR-PRE-POST-IND OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB XSUB) = 'O'
              GO TO 8520-ASSIGN-OUTBOUND-CITY.

                 RSP06-IBR-SAIL-DATE OF RSP06-NEW)  
              GO TO 8510-NEXT-PICF-ENTRY.

           ELSE

                    'A' OR 'B')

                      RSP06-PTFR-LOC-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB XSUB).

           EXIT.

              MOVE NSUB         TO N18-SIGNED   
              MOVE N18-UNSIGNED TO DPP42-HOLD-PAX-SEQ-NUM

       8802-CALL-CANCEL-ORDER.  
           MOVE LOW-VALUES      TO STP30-INPUT-INFO.

                                 DPP01-COMMON-INFO  
                                 STP30-INPUT-INFO   
                                 STP30-OUTPUT-INFO.

                                    DPP42-SUB-MSG-SOURCE (1)

                 END-IF

              ELSE

           PERFORM VARYING EOR-SUB FROM 1 BY 1  
                                  UNTIL EOR-SUB > STP30-O-EOR-CNT   

              MOVE STP30-O-TRANSACTION-TYPE (EOR-SUB)   
                                          TO ARP41-TRANSACTION-TYPE 
              MOVE STP30-O-TRANSACTION-AMT (EOR-SUB)
                                          TO ARP41-TRANSACTION-AMT

                                          TO ARP41-EXPIRATION-DATE

                                          TO ARP41-COMPANY-CODE

                  ELSE

                  END-IF
              END-IF

           END-PERFORM.

           MOVE N18-UNSIGNED TO DPP42-HOLD-PAX-SEQ-NUM.

       8870-RESET-TIER-DATA.
           IF OSUB > 0 AND WS-CHG-SAILING-FLAG = 0 AND  
                 WS-REACTIVATE-FLAG = 0 AND 
                 WS-PAX-RATE-CHG-FLAG (NSUB) = 0 AND

                        NEW-SAIL-CNT.   

           IF RSP06-CIF-EXIST-IND OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) = 'N' OR

              IF WS-PAX-EARN-SAIL-DAYS-IND (NSUB) = 'Y'

               GIVING DPP02-NUMBER-DAYS.

           PERFORM DPP10-DETERMINE-RETURN-DATE. 

           IF DPP02-SYSTEM-DATE > DPP02-RETURN-DATE 
              GO TO 8872-DETERMINE-TREAT-AS.

           MOVE ZERO TO BTB-SUB.

           PERFORM VARYING SUB FROM 1 BY 1  
                   UNTIL SUB > RSP06-PAX-CNT OF RSP06-BTB   
              IF RSP06-PAX-FIRST-NAME OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) =

                 MOVE RSP06-PAX-CNT OF RSP06-BTB TO SUB

                           RSP06-GUEST-OFFER-CNT OF RSP06-BTB OR

                                        OF RSP06-BTB (WS-OFFER-SUB) AND

           IF WS-OFFER-SUB > RSP06-GUEST-OFFER-CNT OF RSP06-BTB

       8873-NEXT-TIER-CODE. 
           ADD 1 TO SUB.

           IF SUB > RSP92-O-TIER-CNT
              IF NEW-TIER-SUB = ZERO
                 MOVE 961 TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX   
                 GO TO 9200-EDIT-ERROR-MSG  
              ELSE  
                 IF RSP06-CIF-EXIST-IND OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) = 'Y' AND   
                       RSP06-CIF-TIER-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) > SPACES 
                    IF RSP06-PDI-CURRENT-TIER-NAME OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)  
                          <= ' '
                       MOVE 962 TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX 
                       GO TO 9200-EDIT-ERROR-MSG
                    END-IF  
                 END-IF 
              END-IF
              GO TO 8874-FINISH-TIER-RESET. 

           IF RSP06-CIF-EXIST-IND OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) = 'Y' 
              IF RSP06-CIF-TIER-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) =  
                   RSP92-O-TIER-CODE (SUB)  
                 MOVE RSP92-O-NAME (SUB) TO 
                      RSP06-PDI-CURRENT-TIER-NAME OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB).  

           IF RSP06-PAX-TEMP-TIER-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) =
                RSP92-O-TIER-CODE (SUB) 
              MOVE SUB TO NEW-TIER-SUB  
              GO TO 8873-NEXT-TIER-CODE.

           IF RSP06-CIF-EXIST-IND OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) = 'Y' AND 
                 RSP06-CIF-TIER-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) =  
                 RSP92-O-TIER-CODE (SUB)
              MOVE SUB TO NEW-TIER-SUB  
              GO TO 8873-NEXT-TIER-CODE.

           IF RSP06-CIF-EXIST-IND OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) = 'Y' AND 
                 RSP06-CIF-GRANDFATHER-IND OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) = 1 AND  
                 RSP92-O-GRANDFATHERED-TO-FLAG (SUB) = 1
              IF NEW-SAIL-CNT >=
                    RSP06-CIF-GRANDFATHER-SAILINGS OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)  
                 MOVE SUB TO NEW-TIER-SUB   
                 GO TO 8873-NEXT-TIER-CODE. 

           IF NEW-SAIL-DAYS <= RSP92-O-CRUISE-DAYS-MAX (SUB)
              IF NEW-TIER-SUB = 0   
                 MOVE SUB TO NEW-TIER-SUB   
              ELSE  
                 IF NEW-SAIL-DAYS > 
                       RSP92-O-CRUISE-DAYS-MAX (NEW-TIER-SUB)   
                    MOVE SUB TO NEW-TIER-SUB.   

           GO TO 8873-NEXT-TIER-CODE.   

       8874-FINISH-TIER-RESET.  
           MOVE RSP92-O-NAME (NEW-TIER-SUB) TO  
                RSP06-PDI-SAIL-TIER-NAME OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB).   
           MOVE RSP92-O-TIER-CODE (NEW-TIER-SUB) TO 
                RSP06-PDI-SAIL-TIER-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB).   

           IF RSP92-O-VIP-FLAG (NEW-TIER-SUB) = 1   
              MOVE 'Y' TO RSP06-PDI-VIP-IND OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB).

           IF OSUB = ZERO OR WS-CHG-SAILING-FLAG = 1 OR 
                 WS-REACTIVATE-FLAG = 1 OR  
                 WS-PAX-RATE-CHG-FLAG (NSUB) = 1 OR 
                 WS-PAX-PST-GUEST-CHG-IND (NSUB) = 'Y'  
              IF  RSP06-CIF-EXIST-IND OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) = 'N' 
                  MOVE SPACES   TO  
                       RSP06-PAX-RATE-TIER-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) 
              ELSE  
                  MOVE RSP06-CIF-TIER-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) TO   
                       RSP06-PAX-RATE-TIER-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB).

       8877-UPDATE-PMR-TIER-MET.
           IF RSP06-CIF-TIER-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) <= SPACES 
              GO TO 8879-EXIT.  

           MOVE ZERO TO PMR-SUB.

       8878-NEXT-RATE.  
           ADD 1 TO PMR-SUB.

           IF PMR-SUB > PMR-CNT 
              GO TO 8879-EXIT.  

           IF WS-PMR-TIER-MET-IND (PMR-SUB) = 'Y'   

              GO TO 8878-NEXT-RATE. 


           PERFORM VARYING SUB FROM 1 BY 1  
                   UNTIL SUB > WS-PMR-TIER-CNT (PMR-SUB)
              IF RSP06-PAX-RATE-TIER-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) >=
                   WS-PMR-TIER-CODE (PMR-SUB SUB)   
                 MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PMR-TIER-MET-IND (PMR-SUB)  
                 MOVE WS-PMR-TIER-CNT (PMR-SUB) TO SUB  
              END-IF
           END-PERFORM. 

           GO TO 8878-NEXT-RATE.

       8879-EXIT.   
           EXIT.

       8880-UPDATE-IB-DINING-CODE.  
LTPROD     COPY SSP09INT.   
LTPROD     MOVE 'LOYALTY'              TO SSP09-I-CODE. 
           MOVE 'PROD'                 TO SSP09-I-TYPE. 
           CALL 'SSC09GCD' USING DPP42-COMMON-DATA-FIELDS   
                                 DPP01-COMMON-INFO  
                                 SSP09-INPUT-PARAMS 
                                 SSP09-OUTPUT-PARAMS.   
           IF DPP42-SUB-MSG-CTR > 0 AND DPP42-SUB-MSG-STATUS (1) > 1
              GO TO 9500-RETURN-SUBROUTINE-ERROR.   
LTPROD     MOVE SSP09-O-DESCRIPTION     TO WS-LOYALTY-PILOT-IND.
           IF WS-TIER-CHG-FLAG = 0  
              GO TO 8889-EXIT.  

           MOVE SPACES TO RSP06-IB-DINING-PROCESS-CODE OF RSP06-NEW.

           IF WS-PAST-GUEST-FOUND-IND = 'N' 
              GO TO 8889-EXIT.  

           MOVE ZERO   TO PSUB. 

       8881-NEXT-GUEST. 
           ADD 1 TO PSUB.   

           IF PSUB > RSP06-PAX-CNT OF RSP06-NEW 
              IF RSP06-IB-DINING-PROCESS-CODE OF RSP06-NEW = SPACES 
                 MOVE 963 TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX   
                 GO TO 9200-EDIT-ERROR-MSG  
              ELSE  
                 GO TO 8889-EXIT.   
LTPROD     IF WS-LOYALTY-PILOT-IND = 'Y' AND
              RSP06-PDI-SAIL-TIER-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (PSUB) <= SPACES
              GO TO 8881-NEXT-GUEST 
LTPROD     END-IF.  

           MOVE 0 TO NEW-TIER-SUB.  

           PERFORM VARYING SUB FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL SUB > RSP92-O-TIER-CNT 
              IF RSP06-PDI-SAIL-TIER-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (PSUB) = 
                    RSP92-O-TIER-CODE (SUB) 
                 MOVE SUB TO NEW-TIER-SUB   
                 MOVE RSP92-O-TIER-CNT TO SUB   
              END-IF
           END-PERFORM  
           IF NEW-TIER-SUB = 0  
              MOVE 964 TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX  
              GO TO 9200-EDIT-ERROR-MSG.

           IF RSP92-O-DINING-CODE (NEW-TIER-SUB) <= SPACES  
              GO TO 8881-NEXT-GUEST.

           IF RSP92-O-DINING-CODE (NEW-TIER-SUB) = 'C'  
              MOVE RSP92-O-DINING-CODE (NEW-TIER-SUB) TO
                  RSP06-IB-DINING-PROCESS-CODE OF RSP06-NEW 
              GO TO 8889-EXIT.  

           IF RSP92-O-DINING-CODE (NEW-TIER-SUB) = 'W'  
              MOVE RSP92-O-DINING-CODE (NEW-TIER-SUB) TO
                  RSP06-IB-DINING-PROCESS-CODE OF RSP06-NEW 
              GO TO 8881-NEXT-GUEST.

           IF RSP06-IB-DINING-PROCESS-CODE OF RSP06-NEW = 'W'   
              GO TO 8881-NEXT-GUEST.

           MOVE RSP92-O-DINING-CODE (NEW-TIER-SUB) TO   
                RSP06-IB-DINING-PROCESS-CODE OF RSP06-NEW   

           GO TO 8881-NEXT-GUEST.   

       8889-EXIT.   
           EXIT.

       8890-VAL-DEPOSIT.

           MOVE ZEROES                 TO LRSUB.

           PERFORM VARYING SUB FROM 1 BY 1  
               UNTIL SUB > RSP86-O-PAYMENT-TYPE-CNT 
               IF RSP86-O-PAYMENT-TYPE (SUB) = WS-PAYMENT-TYPE  
                  MOVE SUB             TO LRSUB 
                  MOVE RSP86-O-PAYMENT-TYPE-CNT TO SUB  
               END-IF   
           END-PERFORM. 

           IF LRSUB = 0 
              MOVE 670                 TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX  
              GO TO 9200-EDIT-ERROR-MSG.

       8899-EXIT.   
           EXIT.

       8900-VALIDATE-PRIZEWINNER.   

           IF  (WS-NEW-BKG-FLAG            = 0 AND  
                WS-NAME-CHG-FLAG    (NSUB) = 0 AND  
                WS-CHG-RATE-FLAG           = 0 AND  
                WS-NEW-PAX-FLAG            = 0 AND  
                WS-CITY-CHG-FLAG    (NSUB) = 0 AND  
                WS-PAX-PKG-ADD-FLAG (NSUB) = 0) 
                GO TO 8909-EXIT 
           END-IF.  

           IF RSP06-PAX-FARE-TYPE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)= 'C'  
              AND RSP06-PPR-CNT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) NOT = 1 
              GO TO 8909-EXIT.  

           MOVE FUNCTION UPPER-CASE (RSP06-PAX-FIRST-NAME   
                  OF RSP06-NEW(NSUB)) TO WS-FIRST-NAME. 
           MOVE FUNCTION UPPER-CASE (RSP06-PAX-LAST-NAME
                  OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)) TO WS-LAST-NAME. 

           IF WS-FIRST-NAME = 'WINNER' OR 'WINNERS' OR 'PRIZE' OR   
                'PRIZES' OR 'PRIZE WINNER' OR 'PRIZE WINNERS' OR
                'PRIZESWINNER' OR 'PRIZESWINNERS' OR 'PRIZEWINNERS' OR  
                'TBA' OR 'PRIZEWINNER'  
              IF RSP25-OVR-FLYA-NAMES-FLG = 1   
                 MOVE 1 TO RSP90-OVR-FLYA-NAMES-FLG 
              ELSE  
                 MOVE 150 TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX   
                 GO TO 9200-EDIT-ERROR-MSG  
              END-IF
           END-IF.  

           IF WS-LAST-NAME = 'WINNER' OR 'WINNERS' OR 'PRIZE' OR
                'PRIZES' OR 'PRIZE WINNER' OR 'PRIZE WINNERS' OR
                'PRIZESWINNER' OR 'PRIZESWINNERS' OR 'PRIZEWINNERS' OR  
                'TBA' OR 'PRIZEWINNER'  
              IF RSP25-OVR-FLYA-NAMES-FLG = 1   
                 MOVE 1 TO RSP90-OVR-FLYA-NAMES-FLG 
              ELSE  
                 MOVE 150 TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX   
                 GO TO 9200-EDIT-ERROR-MSG  
              END-IF
           END-IF.  

       8909-EXIT.   
           EXIT.


       8910-TOT-PAX-IBPIR-UPG.  
      *    NSUB must be set to the PAX position we want to check.   
           MOVE 0    TO WS-TOT-PAX-IBPIR-UPG.   
           IF      (RSP06-IBPIR-READ-IND OF RSP06-NEW = 'Y')
               AND (RSP06-IBPIR-EXIST-IND OF RSP06-NEW = 'Y')   
             PERFORM
                 VARYING  IBPIR-SUB 
                     FROM 1 BY 1
                 UNTIL  (  IBPIR-SUB
                         > RSP06-IBPIR-ENTRY-CNT OF RSP06-NEW)  
               IF  (  RSP06-IBPIR-ITEM-TYPE OF RSP06-OLD (IBPIR-SUB)
                    = 'U')  
                 ADD    IBPIR-PAX-UPGRADE-AMT (IBPIR-SUB, NSUB) 
                     TO WS-TOT-PAX-IBPIR-UPG
               END-IF   
             END-PERFORM
           END-IF.  
       8919-EXIT.   

       8920-MOVE-DEL-PKG.   

           PERFORM VARYING PKG-DEL-SUB FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL
               PKG-DEL-SUB > PKG-DEL-CNT
               MOVE WS-PDEL-PAX-SUB     (PKG-DEL-SUB)   
                                        TO NSUB 
               MOVE WS-PDEL-OLD-PAX-SUB (PKG-DEL-SUB)   
                                        TO OSUB 
               MOVE WS-PDEL-OLD-PPR-SUB (PKG-DEL-SUB)   
                                        TO OPPR-SUB 
               MOVE ZERO                TO PPR-SUB  

               PERFORM VARYING SUB FROM 1 BY 1  
                   UNTIL SUB > RSP06-PPR-CNT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)
                   IF  RSP06-PPR-PKG-TYPE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB SUB) = 
                       RSP06-PPR-PKG-TYPE OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB OPPR-SUB)  
                       MOVE SUB         TO PPR-SUB  
                       MOVE RSP06-PPR-CNT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)   
                                        TO SUB  
                   END-IF   
               END-PERFORM  

               IF  PPR-SUB = 0  
                   ADD 1                TO  
                                       RSP06-PPR-CNT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)

                   IF  RSP06-PPR-CNT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) >  
                       RSP06-PPR-TABLE-MAX  
                       MOVE 102         TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX 
                       GO TO 9200-EDIT-ERROR-MSG
                   END-IF   

                   IF  RSP06-PPR-CANCEL-DATE OF RSP06-OLD   
                       (OSUB OPPR-SUB) <= ZEROES
                       MOVE RSP06-PPR-CNT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)   
                                        TO PPR-SUB  
                       MOVE RSP06-PPR-ENTRY OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB OPPR-SUB)
                                        TO RSP06-PPR-ENTRY OF   
                                           RSP06-NEW (NSUB PPR-SUB) 
                       MOVE DPP02-SYSTEM-DATE   
                                        TO RSP06-PPR-CANCEL-DATE OF 
                                           RSP06-NEW (NSUB PPR-SUB) 
                       MOVE SPACES      TO RSP06-PPR-PKG-NUM OF 
                                           RSP06-NEW (NSUB PPR-SUB) 
                       MOVE ZEROES      TO RSP06-PPR-PKG-AMT OF 
                                           RSP06-NEW (NSUB PPR-SUB) 
                   ELSE 
                       MOVE RSP06-PPR-CNT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)   
                                        TO PPR-SUB  
                       MOVE RSP06-PPR-ENTRY OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB OPPR-SUB)
                                        TO RSP06-PPR-ENTRY OF   
                                           RSP06-NEW (NSUB PPR-SUB) 
                   END-IF   
                   IF  RSP06-PPR-EXIST-IND OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) = 'N'
                       MOVE 'Y'         TO RSP06-PPR-EXIST-IND OF   
                                           RSP06-NEW (NSUB) 
                   END-IF   
               END-IF   
           END-PERFORM. 

       8920-MOVE-DEL-PKG-EXIT.  
           EXIT.

       8930-MOVE-REMOVE-XFR.

           PERFORM VARYING XFR-RMV-SUB FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL
               XFR-RMV-SUB > XFR-REMOVE-CNT 
               MOVE WS-XRMV-PAX-SUB (XFR-RMV-SUB)   
                                         TO NSUB
               MOVE WS-XRMV-OLD-PAX-SUB (XFR-RMV-SUB)   
                                         TO OSUB
               MOVE WS-XRMV-OLD-PTFR-SUB (XFR-RMV-SUB)  
                                         TO OXSUB   
               MOVE ZEROES               TO PTFR-SUB

               PERFORM VARYING SUB FROM 1 BY 1  
                   UNTIL SUB > RSP06-PTFR-TRANSFER-CNT OF RSP06-NEW 
                                                                (NSUB)  
                   IF  RSP06-PTFR-PRE-POST-IND OF RSP06-NEW 
                                                  (NSUB SUB) =  
                       RSP06-PTFR-PRE-POST-IND OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB OXSUB)
                       MOVE SUB          TO PTFR-SUB
                       MOVE RSP06-PTFR-TRANSFER-CNT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) 
                                         TO SUB 
                   END-IF   
               END-PERFORM  

               IF  PTFR-SUB = 0 
                   ADD 1                 TO 
                        RSP06-PTFR-TRANSFER-CNT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) 
                   IF  RSP06-PTFR-TRANSFER-CNT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) >
                       RSP06-PTFR-TABLE-MAX 
                       MOVE 1064         TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX
                       GO TO 9200-EDIT-ERROR-MSG
                   END-IF   
                   MOVE RSP06-PTFR-TRANSFER-CNT OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) 
                                         TO PTFR-SUB
                   MOVE RSP06-PTFR-CALC-KEY OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB) 
                                         TO 
                      RSP06-PTFR-CALC-KEY OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)   
                   MOVE RSP06-PTFR-DETAIL OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB OXSUB) 
                                         TO RSP06-PTFR-DETAIL   
                                          OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB PTFR-SUB)  
                   IF ( RSP06-PTFR-CANCEL-DATE OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB OXSUB)
                                                           <= 0 )   
                      MOVE DPP02-SYSTEM-DATE
                                         TO 
                           RSP06-PTFR-CANCEL-DATE OF RSP06-NEW  
                                                       (NSUB PTFR-SUB)  
                      MOVE ZEROES        TO RSP06-PTFR-AMT  OF  
                                            RSP06-NEW (NSUB PTFR-SUB)   
                   END-IF   
                   IF  RSP06-PTFR-EXIST-IND OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) = 'N'   
                       MOVE 'Y'          TO RSP06-PTFR-EXIST-IND OF 
                                            RSP06-NEW (NSUB)
                   END-IF   
               END-IF   
           END-PERFORM. 

       8930-MOVE-REMOVE-XFR-EXIT.   
           EXIT.

       8940-CALL-RSO86. 
           COPY RSP86INT.   

           MOVE 1 TO WS-CALLED-RSO86-FLAG.  
           MOVE RSP06-IBR-LOCALITY-CODE OF RSP06-NEW TO 
                RSP86-I-LOCALITY-CODE.  

           CALL 'RSC86GLD' USING DPP42-COMMON-DATA-FIELDS,  
                                 DPP01-COMMON-INFO, 
                                 RSP86-INPUT-PARAMS,
                                 RSP86-OUTPUT-PARAMS.   

           IF (DPP42-SUB-MSG-CTR > 0) AND DPP42-SUB-MSG-STATUS (1) > 1  
                 GO TO 9500-RETURN-SUBROUTINE-ERROR.

       8949-CALL-RSO86-EXIT.
           EXIT.

       8950-VALIDATE-AGE-RESTRICTIONS.  
           IF WS-APPLY-AGE-FLAG = 0 OR  
              (RSP06-IBR-SAIL-DATE OF RSP06-NEW NOT > DPP02-SYSTEM-DATE)
              GO TO 8950-EXIT   
           END-IF.  
           IF RSP25-OVR-AGE-RESTRICT-IND = 1
              MOVE 1 TO RSP90-OVR-AGE-RESTRICT-FLG  
              GO TO 8950-EXIT   
           END-IF.  

           IF RSP06-PAX-BIRTH-DATE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) NOT = ZEROES 
              MOVE RSP06-PAX-BIRTH-DATE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) TO  
                  DPP02-BD-YYYYMMDD-DATE
              MOVE RSP06-IBR-SAIL-DATE OF RSP06-NEW TO DPP02-SAIL-DATE  
              PERFORM DPP10-COMPUTE-GUEST-AGE   
              IF (DPP02-YEAR-CNT > 1)   
                 MOVE DPP02-YEAR-CNT TO N18-SIGNED  
                 MOVE N18-UNSIGNED  
                          TO RSP06-PAX-AGE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)  
                 MOVE 'Y' TO RSP06-PAX-AGE-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) 
              ELSE  
                 MOVE DPP02-MONTH-CNT  TO N18-SIGNED
                 MOVE N18-UNSIGNED  
                     TO RSP06-PAX-AGE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)   
                 MOVE 'M'    TO RSP06-PAX-AGE-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)  
              END-IF
           END-IF.  

           IF RSP06-PAX-AGE-CODE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) = 'M'  
              COMPUTE WS-MIN-AGE =  
                           RSP06-PAX-AGE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) / 12   
           ELSE 
              MOVE RSP06-PAX-AGE OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB) TO WS-MIN-AGE  
           END-IF.  
           IF WS-MIN-AGE < WS-RESTRICTION-AGE   
              MOVE 1086                  TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX
              IF WS-NEW-BKG-FLAG = 1 OR WS-NEW-PAX-FLAG = 1 
                 MOVE 1085               TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX
              END-IF
              IF WS-REACTIVATE-FLAG = 1 
                 MOVE 1087            TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX   
              END-IF
              GO TO 9200-EDIT-ERROR-MSG 
           END-IF.  
       8950-EXIT.   
           EXIT.


       8960-VALID-SSCIR-DATA.   
           IF  (TDP01-SHIP-CODE = WS-SSCIR-SHIP-CODE)  AND  
               (TDP01-SAIL-DATE-YYYYMMDD = WS-SSCIR-SAIL-DATE)  AND 
               (TDP01-DURATION-DAYS = WS-SSCIR-DURATION-DAYS)   
                GO TO 8960-VALIDATE-SCIR-TABLE  
           END-IF.  

           MOVE TDP01-SHIP-CODE        TO SSCIR-SHIP-CODE   
           MOVE TDP01-SAIL-DATE-YYYYMMDD
                                       TO SSCIR-SAIL-DATE   
           MOVE TDP01-DURATION-DAYS    TO SSCIR-DURATION-DAYS.  

           FETCH SAIL-STAGGERED-CHECK-IN-REC RECORD 
                      ON ERROR GO TO 8960-SCCR-NOT-SET-UP.  

           MOVE TDP01-SHIP-CODE        TO WS-SSCIR-SHIP-CODE.   
           MOVE TDP01-SAIL-DATE-YYYYMMDD
                                       TO WS-SSCIR-SAIL-DATE.   
           MOVE TDP01-DURATION-DAYS    TO WS-SSCIR-DURATION-DAYS.   

       8960-VALIDATE-SCIR-TABLE.

           MOVE 'N'             TO WS-SSCIR-VALID-ID
                                   WS-SZONE-FOUND-IND   
                                   WS-STAG-TABLE-ID-NOT-VALID.  

           MOVE ZEROES          TO WS-SZONE-REM-GUEST-CNT   
                                   WS-TEMP-SSCIR-SUBZONE-CNT.   
           MOVE SPACES          TO WS-TEMP-SSCIR-BOARDING-ZONE. 

           IF WS-VALIDATE-CHECKIN-IND = 'Y' 
              CONTINUE  
           ELSE 
              IF WS-VALIDATE-CHECKOUT-IND = 'Y' 
                 GO TO  8961-VALIDATE-FOR-DEBARK-ID 
              END-IF
           END-IF.  

            PERFORM VARYING WS-SSCIR-SUB FROM 1 BY 1
                UNTIL WS-SSCIR-SUB > SSCIR-TABLE-CNT OR 
                WS-SSCIR-VALID-ID  = 'Y'
                IF SSCIR-TABLE-ID (WS-SSCIR-SUB) =  
                   RSP06-IBR-SSCIR-TABLE-ID OF RSP06-NEW
                                                         AND
                   SSCIR-EMBARK-DEBARK-IND (WS-SSCIR-SUB) = 'E' 
                   MOVE WS-SSCIR-SUB  TO SSCIR-SUB  
                   IF  SSCIR-CLOSED-FOR-ALL-IND (WS-SSCIR-SUB) = 'Y'
                       MOVE 1098      TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX   
                       GO TO 9200-EDIT-ERROR-MSG
                   END-IF   
                   IF (SSCIR-CAPACITY (WS-SSCIR-SUB) <= 
                       SSCIR-CONFIRMED (WS-SSCIR-SUB )) 
219968                 IF WS-OVERRIDE-SW = 'ON' 
219968                    IF WS-PX-SUITE-IND = 'Y'  
219968                       MOVE 'Y' TO WS-SSCIR-VALID-ID  
219968                    ELSE  
219968                       MOVE 'Y' TO WS-STAG-TABLE-ID-CAP-MAXED 
219968                    END-IF
219968                 ELSE 
P48908                    MOVE 'Y' TO WS-STAG-TABLE-ID-CAP-MAXED
219968                 END-IF   
                   ELSE 
                      MOVE 'Y' TO WS-SSCIR-VALID-ID 
                   END-IF   

                   PERFORM VARYING WS-SZONE-SUB FROM 1 BY 1 
                           UNTIL  (WS-SZONE-FOUND-IND = 'Y')         OR 
                                  (WS-SZONE-SUB > SSCIR-SUBZONE-CNT 
                                                     (WS-SSCIR-SUB))
                      COMPUTE WS-SZONE-REM-GUEST-CNT =  
                              WS-MAXIMUM-GUEST-CNT   -  
                              SSCIR-SUBZONE-GUEST-CNT   
                                          (WS-SSCIR-SUB WS-SZONE-SUB)   
                      IF WS-SZONE-REM-GUEST-CNT >=  
                                          RSP06-PAX-CNT OF RSP06-NEW
                         MOVE 'Y'     TO WS-SZONE-FOUND-IND 
                      END-IF
                   END-PERFORM  

                   IF WS-SZONE-FOUND-IND = 'Y'  
                      SUBTRACT 1 FROM WS-SZONE-SUB  
                      PERFORM VARYING NSUB FROM 1 BY 1  
                              UNTIL   NSUB > RSP06-PAX-CNT OF RSP06-NEW 
                         MOVE SSCIR-BOARDING-ZONE  (WS-SSCIR-SUB)   
                                      TO WS-TEMP-SSCIR-BOARDING-ZONE
                         IF WS-SZONE-SUB = SSCIR-SUBZONE-CNT
                                                   (WS-SSCIR-SUB)   
                            MOVE SSCIR-SUBZONE-CNT (WS-SSCIR-SUB)   
                                      TO WS-TEMP-SSCIR-SUBZONE-CNT  
                         ELSE   
                            MOVE WS-SZONE-SUB   
                                      TO WS-TEMP-SSCIR-SUBZONE-CNT  
                         END-IF 
                         STRING WS-TEMP-SSCIR-BOARDING-ZONE 
                                                 DELIMITED BY SIZE  
                                WS-TEMP-SSCIR-SUBZONE-CNT   
                                                 DELIMITED BY SIZE  
                           INTO RSP06-PAX-BOARDING-ZONE    OF RSP06-NEW 
                                                                  (NSUB)
                      END-PERFORM   
                   ELSE 
                      COMPUTE WS-TEMP-SSCIR-SUBZONE-CNT =   
                              SSCIR-SUBZONE-CNT (WS-SSCIR-SUB) + 1  
                      IF WS-TEMP-SSCIR-SUBZONE-CNT > 40 
                         MOVE 1100    TO DPP42-HOLD-MSG-INDEX   
                         GO TO 9200-EDIT-ERROR-MSG  
                      END-IF
                      PERFORM VARYING NSUB FROM 1 BY 1  
                              UNTIL   NSUB > RSP06-PAX-CNT OF RSP06-NEW 
                         MOVE SSCIR-BOARDING-ZONE (WS-SSCIR-SUB)

                                WS-TEMP-SSCIR-SUBZONE-CNT

                                                                  (NSUB)
                      END-PERFORM   
                   END-IF   
                END-IF  
            END-PERFORM

               WS-SSCIR-VALID-ID  = 'N' 
               GO TO 8960-SCCR-NOT-SET-UP   
            ELSE
               GO TO 8960-VALID-SSCIR-DATA-EXIT.

                   END-IF   
               END-IF   
           END-PERFORM.

               WS-SSCIR-VALID-ID  = 'N'

983713           WS-COUNTRY NOT = 'CA' AND  
983713           WS-COUNTRY NOT = 'PR'  
983713             GO TO 8995-NEXT-STATE
983713          END-IF  
983713        ELSE  
983713        IF  RSP06-PAX-RESIDENCE-COUNTRY OF RSP06-NEW (NSUB)   
983713           NOT = WS-COUNTRY   
983713             GO TO 8995-NEXT-STATE
983713        END-IF
983713      END-IF. 
983713      IF    WS-STATE-COUNT = 2 AND
983713            WS-CHG-PAX     = 1
983713        IF  RSP06-PIAR-COUNTRY OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB)
983713                               NOT > SPACES   
983713          IF WS-COUNTRY NOT = 'US' AND
983713           WS-COUNTRY NOT = 'CA' AND  
983713           WS-COUNTRY NOT = 'PR'  
983713             GO TO 8995-NEXT-STATE
983713          END-IF  
983713        ELSE  
983713        IF  RSP06-PIAR-COUNTRY  OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB)   
983713           NOT = WS-COUNTRY   
983713             GO TO 8995-NEXT-STATE
983713        END-IF
983713      END-IF. 
983713*********If the date is null there is no restriction  
983713      IF WS-V-NULL-IND = WS-NULL-IND  
983713        GO TO 8995-CLOSE-REST-CURSOR  
983713      END-IF. 
983713      MOVE WS-RDATE-X-Y       TO WS-RDATE-N-Y.
983713      MOVE WS-RDATE-X-M       TO WS-RDATE-N-M.
983713      MOVE WS-RDATE-X-D       TO WS-RDATE-N-D.
983713**Adding VPP or VPP date past Allowed date or VPP date = 0 and
983713**todays date past Vpp allowed date.  
983713      IF WS-CHG-PAX = 1   
983713        IF (RSP06-TIR-EXIST-IND OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB) = 'N' 
983713          AND DPP02-SYSTEM-DATE >= WS-NDATE) OR   
983713         (RSP06-TIR-EXIST-IND OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB) = 'Y' AND   
983713          (RSP06-TIR-INSURED-DATE OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB) 
983713                                          >= WS-NDATE OR  
983713           (RSP06-TIR-INSURED-DATE OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB)
983713                                          NOT > ZEROS   AND   
983713              DPP02-SYSTEM-DATE >= WS-NDATE)))
983713          MOVE 0 TO WS-STATE-ALLOWED  
983713*       ELSE  
983713*        IF RSP06-PAX-STATE OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB) NOT = 
983713*                                      WS-STATE   
983713*           AND  WS-STATE-COUNT = 1   
983713*           AND  DPP02-SYSTEM-DATE >= WS-NDATE AND
983713*           RSP06-PAX-STATE OF RSP06-OLD (OSUB) > SPACES  
983713*           MOVE 0 TO WS-STATE-ALLOWED
983713*        END-IF   
983713        END-IF
983713      ELSE
983713        IF   DPP02-SYSTEM-DATE >= WS-NDATE
983713          MOVE 0 TO WS-STATE-ALLOWED. 
983713 8995-CLOSE-REST-CURSOR.  
983713      EXEC SQL
983713          CLOSE REST_DATE_CUR 
983713      END-EXEC.   
983713 8995-EXIT.   
983713     EXIT.

TRK2B**                                   RSP90-OVERRIDE-UPG-INTO-FLG   
TRK2B**                                   RSP90-OVERRIDE-META-FLG   
TRK2B**    END-IF.  
TRK2B** 
TRK2B**    IF  (RSP90-OVERRIDE-META-FLG      = 1) OR
TRK2B**        (RSP90-OVERRIDE-UPG-INTO-FLG  = 1) OR
TRK2B**        (RSP90-OVERRIDE-UPGRADE-FLG   = 1) OR
TRK2B**        (RSP90-OVERRIDE-MAX-PAX-FLG   = 1) OR
TRK2B**        (RSP90-OVERRIDE-MIN-PAX-FLG   = 1) OR
TRK2B**        (RSP90-OVERRIDE-OCC-REST-FLG  = 1) OR
TRK2B**        (RSP90-OVERRIDE-PHANTOM-FLG   = 1) OR
TRK2B**        (RSP90-OVERRIDE-RATE-CTLS-FLG = 1) OR
TRK2B**        (RSP90-OVERRIDE-NO-GTEE-FLG   = 1)   
TRK2B**         MOVE 'Y'               TO WS-OVR-SET
TRK2B**    END-IF.  
TRK2B** 
TRK2B**    IF  RSP90-OVERRIDE-CAT-IND-FLG = 1   
TRK2B**        IF  RSP51-I-ADD-PAX-IND = 'Y'
TRK2B**            MOVE 0              TO RSP90-OVERRIDE-CAT-IND-FLG
TRK2B**        ELSE 
TRK2B**            MOVE 'Y'            TO WS-OVR-SET
TRK2B**        END-IF   
TRK2B**    END-IF.  
TRK2B** 
TRK2B**    IF  RSP90-OVERRIDE-MAX-CAB-FLG = 1

TRK2B**            MOVE 0              TO RSP90-OVERRIDE-MAX-CAB-FLG
TRK2B**        ELSE 
TRK2B**            MOVE 'Y'            TO WS-OVR-SET
TRK2B**        END-IF   
TRK2B**    END-IF.  
TRK2B**

TRK2B**        CONTINUE 
TRK2B**    ELSE 
TRK2B**        GO TO 18000-VALIDATE-OVERRIDES-EXIT  
TRK2B**    END-IF.

TRK2B**                                   WS11-CPASUB
